sentences.english: The poet writes new words in a book.
sentences.latin: Poeta verba nova in libro scribit.

sentences.english: The Muse loves the poet's words.
sentences.latin: Musa verba poetae amat.

sentences.english: The poet gives a small gift to the Muse.
sentences.latin: Poeta Musae donum parvum dat.

sentences.english: The Muse warns the good poet.
sentences.latin: Musa poetam bonum monet.

sentences.english: A friend hears the poet's words and answers.
sentences.latin: Amicus verba poetae audit et respondet.

sentences.english: The good friend praises the Muse's gift.
sentences.latin: Amicus bonus donum Musae laudat.

sentences.english: And so the poet writes a new book.
sentences.latin: Itaque poeta librum novum scribit.

sentences.english: Our consul gives new laws to the people.
sentences.latin: Consul noster leges novas populo dat.

sentences.english: The people trust the wise consul's new laws.
sentences.latin: Populus legibus novis consulis sapientis credit.

sentences.english: The old senate house is guarded by loyal soldiers.
sentences.latin: Curia vetus a militibus fidelibus custoditur.

sentences.english: Our wise consul commands the loyal soldiers.
sentences.latin: Consul noster sapiens militibus fidelibus imperat.

sentences.english: The common people love long peace and order.
sentences.latin: Plebs pacem longam et ordinem amat.

sentences.english: The consul's law is praised by all the people.
sentences.latin: Lex consulis ab omni populo laudatur.

sentences.english: And so peace is preserved by the loyal consul.
sentences.latin: Itaque pax a consule fideli servatur.

sentences.english: The fierce and immortal dragon guards the high mountain of the old kingdom.
sentences.latin: Draco ferox et immortalis montem altum regni veteris custodit.

sentences.english: The brave soldiers of our great legion attack the fierce dragon.
sentences.latin: Milites fortes legionis nostrae magnae draconem ferocem petunt.

sentences.english: The dragon frightens the brave soldiers of the legion with fierce fire and severe anger.
sentences.latin: Draco milites fortes legionis igne feroci et ira gravi terret.

sentences.english: But the leader's great courage protects the legion's brave soldiers.
sentences.latin: Sed ducis virtus magna milites fortes legionis servat.

sentences.english: The loyal cohort of our brave soldiers guards the old mountain's rampart.
sentences.latin: Militum fortium nostrorum cohors fidelis vallum montis veteris custodit.

sentences.english: And so the high mountain is guarded by the loyal legion.
sentences.latin: Itaque mons altus a legione fideli custoditur.
